# Gaan Bristy

> Gaan Bristy (গান বৃষ্টি) is a popular StarMaker music family in Bangladesh. Social-media personalities, professional artists, entrepreneurs and music lovers gather here. Notable members include Artist Agun (StarMaker ID 78003563297), dancer Dolly Iqbal, and Tanna Khan.

- Official site: https://gaanbristy.site/
- Event: Gaan Bristy Get Together 2026
- Date: 19 September 2026, 6:00 PM
- Venue: Gulshan Club, Dhaka
- Organizer: Gaan Bristy Family
- Contact / bKash: 01761870650
